items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Willie, I played with Willie. Willie came out here and we were working someplace and he worked a week or two somewhere out here.

ctx.x: Yeah, Percy started on drums. Drums, yeah.

And then he's now a cornet. He hasn't played drums for years. Is that so? Mm-hmm. So I had never heard him, you know. Willie, I played with Willie. Willie came out here and we were working someplace and he worked a week or two somewhere out here. We were using two clarinets. I think he got out to Navy out here or something. And that's the first time I heard him play. But he went on back to New Orleans.
Yeah. Any other drummers you can remember there? Ever hear of Walter Brundy? Yeah, sure. How was he? He was a good drummer.
